blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan—Around 14,000 security and emergency personnel will be deployed across the Ilocos region to strengthen public safety and road security during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day on Nov. 1 and 2. Police Maj. Cherry Tolentino, chief of the Police Regional Office I public information office, said the deployment would include 6,181 police officers, supported by 1,603 personnel from partner agencies and 6,532 force multipliers. The personnel will secure cemeteries, major thoroughfares and tourist destinations to maintain peace and order, address public safety concerns, and assist residents and travelers, Tolentino said during the Philippine Information Agency’s […]...
